verdicts.title: Characterizing Propositional Proofs as Non-Commutative Formulas
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Does every Boolean tautology have a short propositional-calculus proof? Here, a propositional calculus (i.e. Frege) proof is a proof starting from a set of axioms and deriving new Boolean formulas using a set of fixed sound derivation rules.
